pinned_launcher.scope_note: This bounded package measures one pgain candidate evaluation and commit/reject step, not pspeedy initialization or the launcher's full iterative schedule.

input.layout: [n, dimension, candidate, facility_cost, center_mask, assignments[n], weights[n], current_costs[n], coordinates[n*dimension]]

output.layout: [opened, gain, center_count, center_mask, objective, assignments'[n], costs'[n]]

contract.input_layout: [n, dimension, candidate, facility_cost, center_mask, assignments[n], weights[n], current_costs[n], coordinates[n*dimension]]
contract.preconditions: Nonempty center mask; candidate is not open; assignments target open centers; open centers self-assign at zero cost; current_costs exactly equal weight times squared Euclidean distance.
contract.operation: Rodinia pgain: sum strict direct-switch cost deltas, accumulate current_cost minus candidate_cost per current center otherwise, subtract each strictly positive facility_cost+lower closure value, and open candidate iff resulting delta is strictly negative.
contract.output_layout: little-endian signed i64 words [opened, gain, center_count, center_mask, objective, assignments'[n], costs'[n]]
